legend: You are given n$$$n$$$ segments on a number line; each endpoint of every segment has integer coordinates. Some segments can degenerate to points. Segments can intersect with each other, be nested in each other or even coincide.

The intersection of a sequence of segments is such a maximal set of points (not necesserily having integer coordinates) that each point lies within every segment from the sequence. If the resulting set isn't empty, then it always forms some continuous segment. The length of the intersection is the length of the resulting segment or 0$$$0$$$ in case the intersection is an empty set.

For example, the intersection of segments [1;5]$$$[1;5]$$$ and [3;10]$$$[3;10]$$$ is [3;5]$$$[3;5]$$$ (length 2$$$2$$$), the intersection of segments [1;5]$$$[1;5]$$$ and [5;7]$$$[5;7]$$$ is [5;5]$$$[5;5]$$$ (length 0$$$0$$$) and the intersection of segments [1;5]$$$[1;5]$$$ and [6;6]$$$[6;6]$$$ is an empty set (length 0$$$0$$$).
Your task is to remove exactly one segment from the given sequence in such a way that the intersection of the remaining (n−1)$$$(n - 1)$$$ segments has the maximal possible length.
input: The first line contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (2≤n≤3⋅105$$$2 \le n \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of segments in the sequence.
Each of the next n$$$n$$$ lines contains two integers li$$$l_i$$$ and ri$$$r_i$$$ (0≤li≤ri≤109$$$0 \le l_i \le r_i \le 10^9$$$) — the description of the i$$$i$$$-th segment.
output: Print a single integer — the maximal possible length of the intersection of (n−1)$$$(n - 1)$$$ remaining segments after you remove exactly one segment from the sequence.
note: In the first example you should remove the segment [3;3]$$$[3;3]$$$, the intersection will become [2;3]$$$[2;3]$$$ (length 1$$$1$$$). Removing any other segment will result in the intersection [3;3]$$$[3;3]$$$ (length 0$$$0$$$).

In the second example you should remove the segment [1;3]$$$[1;3]$$$ or segment [2;6]$$$[2;6]$$$, the intersection will become [2;4]$$$[2;4]$$$ (length 2$$$2$$$) or [1;3]$$$[1;3]$$$ (length 2$$$2$$$), respectively. Removing any other segment will result in the intersection [2;3]$$$[2;3]$$$ (length 1$$$1$$$).
In the third example the intersection will become an empty set no matter the segment you remove.

In the fourth example you will get the intersection [3;10]$$$[3;10]$$$ (length 7$$$7$$$) if you remove the segment [1;5]$$$[1;5]$$$ or the intersection [1;5]$$$[1;5]$$$ (length 4$$$4$$$) if you remove the segment [3;10]$$$[3;10]$$$.

legend.ai: 在数轴上给定 n$$$n$$$ 条线段；每条线段的每个端点都具有整数坐标。某些线段可能退化为点。线段之间可能相交、互相嵌套，甚至完全重合。
一系列线段的交集是这样的一个极大点集(不一定具有整数坐标)：该点集中的每个点都位于这系列中的每一条线段内。若结果集不为空，则它总是构成某个连续的线段。交集的长度为结果线段的长度；若交集为空集，则为 0$$$0$$$。
你的任务是从给定序列中恰好删除一个区间，使得剩余的 (n−1)$$$(n - 1)$$$ 个区间的交集长度尽可能大。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$ (2≤n≤3⋅105$$$2 \le n \le 3 \cdot 10^5$$$) — 序列中区间的数量。
接下来的 n$$$n$$$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 li$$$l_i$$$ 和 ri$$$r_i$$$ (0≤li≤ri≤109$$$0 \le l_i \le r_i \le 10^9$$$) — 第 i$$$i$$$ 个区间的描述。

output.ai: 输出一个整数 — 从序列中恰好删除一个区间后，剩余的 (n−1)$$$(n - 1)$$$ 个区间的交集的最大可能长度。

note.ai: 在第三个样例中，无论移除哪条线段，交集都会变成空集。
